_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score coil (3% of 12h windows ±2) plus sentiment already inside Panic band means the rung stays put unless a named breaker hits.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Panic phase; analyst supplies the only explicit forward call (HOLD), narrative is silent/awaiting
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds below ~$78,100 and F&G stays 20-32 with 30d momentum near 50 and funding not flipping negative
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims and holds above ~$78,100 with F&G back through 40, or F&G breaks under 15 with momentum_30d collapsing toward 20 and funding negative (rung down to Capitulation)
